descriptionChirho: The proper name of a son of Japheth (Genesis 10:2,4; 1 Chronicles 1:5,7), the eponymous ancestor of the Ionian Greeks. These clusters carry masculine proper noun morphology (N-proper-ms) and refer to the genealogical figure or to his descendants as a people group in prophetic lists alongside other nations (eng 'Yavan/Javan,' spa 'Javán/Yaván,' arb 'يَاوَانَ/ياوان,' kor '야완,' swa 'Yavani,' hin 'यावान'). The conjunction variants ('and-Yavan') are purely syntactic.

The geographic and political designation for Greece as a nation or territory, used especially in prophetic and late biblical texts (Daniel 8:21, 10:20, 11:2; Zechariah 9:13; Isaiah 66:19). Tagged as N-proper-fs (feminine, following the convention for lands/nations), the multilingual evidence confirms this geographic reading: spa 'Grecia,' arb 'الْيُونَانِ' (al-Yunan, the standard Arabic word for Greece), kor '헬라' (Hellas), swa 'Uyunani' (the Swahili term for Greece), hin 'यावान–का/यावान–के' (with possessive markers indicating a territory).
